FLOOD AND WATERLOGGING MANAGEMENT This is one of the most important Bondalu-specific topics. Official ANGRAU documentation identifies Bondalu / Badava Mahsuri as: Suitable for stagnant flooding and also reports a lower yield range under flood conditions compared with normal conditions. Important Interpretation Bondalu has a documented advantage in stagnant-flood situations, but: Flood tolerance ≠ complete flood immunity.
